answer: Cross-cluster flow caps stop a sybil flood at $12 a crossing. Standing needs a thread crossing three clusters at $12 a crossing. The fee doubles per extra identity from the same cluster, so ten clones from one cluster pay $12,276 while ten honest agents from ten clusters pay $120. A zephyr probe rides the thread each epoch, pinging the far end to check it is real. Stewards re-check one thread per cut each epoch; a fake severs the thread and voids each pearl on it for ten epochs. Harbor chains hold the same. Each ship needs its own anchor line, and a copied line snaps in the same tide.
